page_topic_one_liner: AI visibility monitoring — track brand mentions, citation rates, and share of voice across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI answer engines
differentiator_vs_generic: This is a monitoring/analytics layer for brand presence IN AI answers, NOT traditional SEO rank tracking, NOT a GEO strategy guide alone. Hero must be a multi-engine visibility dashboard with answer snapshots and brand-mention detection highlights — NOT a Google SERP or magnifying glass.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): AI visibility monitoring dashboard — 3 stacked mini LLM answer panels (ChatGPT-style dark, Perplexity-style light, generic warm chat) each with blurred answer text and one brand-name chip highlighted in titian-red accent
Mention-rate trend sparkline with upward arrow and percentage blur badge
Secondary: prompt library sidebar with 3 blurred question rows and checkmark icons
anti_patterns: Google SERP with blue ranked links as hero
Generic growth chart without AI answer panels
